note: Rewritten from the English diagnostic characters of the entry for species 5 in State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat (ZSI); only the soldier (major, medium and minor) is described; the original states Caste known: Soldier and Worker but gives no worker morphology, so no worker section is written. Type locality Balana, Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan, India. In the original the comma in head length 1.8-2,00 is treated as a decimal point and read as 1.80—2.00; the other measurements are translated verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldiers trimorphic (major, medium and minor soldiers), the inner margin of the mandibles with several distinct teeth of unequal size. Major soldier head capsule nearly rectangular, flat, longer than wide, fontanelle distinct, round, situated a little beyond the midpoint; labrum subpentagonal, coronate; postmentum rod-shaped; pronotum flat, nearly trapezoidal, narrower than the head and wider than long. Minor soldier labrum ligulate, not coronate as in the major and medium soldiers.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Polymorphic, with major, medium and minor soldiers. The inner margin of the mandibles with several distinct teeth, from large to small. Major soldier: total body length with mandibles 7.43—8.16 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, flat, longer than wide, head length (to the mandible base) 1.80—2.00 mm, maximum head width 1.35—1.50 mm. Fontanelle distinct, round, situated a little beyond the midpoint. Left and right mandible length 1.43—1.80 mm. Antennae 14—15-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 large. Labrum subpentagonal, coronate, median length 0.70—0.93 mm, maximum width 0.73—0.95 mm. Postmentum rod-shaped, length 1.25—1.48 mm, maximum width 0.53—0.58 mm. Pronotum flat, nearly trapezoidal, narrower than the head, wider than long, length 0.78—0.95 mm, width 1.13—1.35 mm. Cerci 2-segmented; styli single-segmented. Medium soldier: similar to the major soldier but smaller, total body length 5.90—6.80 mm, head length (to the mandible base) 1.50—1.65 mm, maximum head width 1.20—1.25 mm, pronotal width 0.98—1.10 mm; antennae as in the major soldier, 14—15-segmented. Minor soldier: similar to the major and medium soldiers but smaller still, total body length 4.00—5.57 mm, head length (to the mandible base) 1.08—1.40 mm, maximum head width 0.85—1.23 mm; pronotal length 0.49—0.56 mm, width 0.63—0.91 mm; antennae 14—15-segmented. Labrum ligulate, not coronate as in the major and medium soldiers.
